reason: A is the better-aligned proposal because it tests an intrinsic deformation–fracture mechanism in an actual FCC high-/medium-entropy alloy, whereas B largely extrapolates from an all-ceramic HEC/Cr7C3 composite to an unspecified alloy system. A still needs tighter control of mean SFE versus SFE heterogeneity and must account for the suppression of twinning and activation of recovery/cross-slip at elevated temperature, but it remains more relevant and falsifiable for the stated question.
